title.value: GEO-Bench: Toward Foundation Models for Earth Monitoring
title.justification: The paper's focus is on proposing a benchmark, GEO-Bench, for developing foundation models for Earth monitoring, which is prominently discussed in the abstract and introduction.
title.quote: To stimulate the development of foundation models for Earth monitoring, we propose a benchmark comprised of six classification and six segmentation tasks...

extractions.description: The paper introduces GEO-Bench, a benchmark comprised of classification and segmentation tasks tailored to evaluate and improve the development of foundation models for Earth monitoring. It highlights the importance of such models in climate change mitigation, adaptation, and climate science. The paper outlines the design principles, datasets transformations, and reporting procedures for using GEO-Bench, emphasizing its role in supporting the machine learning community to develop better pre-trained models for remote sensing tasks related to sustainable development.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper emphasizes the role of machine learning-based Earth monitoring in climate change mitigation, adaptation, and science, demonstrating its central relevance to climate change topics.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Earth monitoring with machine learning-based methods plays an increasing role in climate change mitigation and adaptation as well as climate science...
